rumors.text: Poster summary of FOMC minutes: almost all officials saw further rate hikes likely, a couple said >25bp could be considered if inflation is unfavorable
rumors.why: A more hawkish path than priced would pressure equities, especially long-duration tech

rumors.text: Same minutes summary says many officials saw the AI buildout as a material inflation risk
rumors.why: Fed framing AI capex as inflationary adds pressure on AI leaders already at day lows

rumors.text: UNH slide (now ~-9.7%) blamed by posters on an unconfirmed regulatory proposal; selling extended into the afternoon
rumors.why: A payment-cutting rule would keep weighing on managed care and S&P health care

rumors.text: Posters calling 'full puts into close' and a run to SPY 720 after the minutes
rumors.why: A break of the ~727 intraday low could accelerate selling into the close

plays.reason: Hawkish-sounding minutes summary circulating, NVDA and UNH pinned at lows and SPY slipped back below flat; offset by extreme-fear readings, RSI ~37 and strong small caps
